Command-line reference¶

wvt [options] [file]

wvt --help shows the same list. Values in Hz and seconds accept SI suffixes, for example 2.4M, 250k, 20u or 5m. A unit can follow the value, for example 2.4 MHz or 10 MS/s. wvt does not accept other text after the value (1.5.2 or 12abc). Whole-number options (for example --seed, --gpu-device or the N in --chain-add PATH:N) must be whole numbers in their range. For more information about an option, refer to the page in the last column.

Environment variables¶

Variable

Function

WVT_SCALE

The UI scale, as --scale

WVT_GPU

auto, on or off, as --gpu

WVT_LOG_DIR

The folder for the log file, as --log-dir

TMPDIR

The folder for the log file, if WVT_LOG_DIR is not set

WVT_TX_MAX_GAIN

The maximum TX gain, as --tx-max-gain

WVT_TX_ALLOW

The bands where wvt can transmit, as --tx-allow

WVT_GPU_FORCE_FAIL

Set to 1 to make each GPU call fail. For tests of the CPU fallback

DISPLAY

The X server
